findings.source: the leg-limit checks of _closeSwaps and of each _closeSwapsPerLeg
findings.issue: P11: the per-leg checks are implied by the first combined check; '<= 0' on an unsigned value is '== 0'.
findings.rule: Drop a check implied by a dominating one; print 'x <= 0' for unsigned x as 'x == 0' (or 'not x').

notes: Source loop AmmCloseSwapServiceBaseV1.sol:311 (closing each swap) is dead in this bytecode because liquidationLegLimit is an immutable read as 0 (artifact), so source_loops counts 0. All other ABI functions are immutable getters (const ... = 0) plus version = 2003 and getPoolConfiguration = Bytes(608, 0). The text is consistent with that bytecode. No semantic error found.
summary: Short but faithful: with every immutable read as 0 only empty swap lists pass the leg limit, so the closing loop and per-swap logic are (correctly) absent; only implied repeated checks remain to simplify.
